title: Stale Context in Kotlin AI Agents: Invariant Preservation and Asymptotic Bounds of a Balanced Search Index
topic: Your AI Agent s Memory Is Not Its Source of Truth: The Hidden Risk of Stale Context
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Artificial intelligence agents often maintain an internal memory that is presumed to reflect the true state of the world. In practice, the memory is updated asynchronously and can become stale, leading to incorrect reasoning. This paper introduces a lightweight balanced search index, implemented in Kotlin, that preserves a strict height-balanced and key-ordered invariant while providing amortized $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ point and range queries. We formally prove that the index maintains its invariants under concurrent updates and that the memory footprint remains linear. The design is evaluated through static abstract syntax tree inspection and structural complexity profiling on an AMD EPYC 9V45 platform. The results confirm the theoretical bounds and demonstrate that stale context can be detected and corrected without sacrificing asymptotic performance. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/kotlin-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261108_170113_your_ai_agent_s_memory_is_not}
